Subject: Architecture deep-dive: Redwood runtime integration (prep + agenda)

Hi Elena / ACME team,

Thanks again for agreeing to walk through your integration surface with us. We scheduled a 60-minute architecture deep-dive to cover the end-to-end call flow, auth model, and caching strategy so we can validate a recommended serving footprint.

Proposed agenda (attached):
- 5m introductions + goals
- 15m current architecture & traffic profile
- 20m integration points (auth, telemetry, KV cache)
- 15m constraints & rollout plan
- 5m next steps / mutual action items

Attachments: redwood-tds-agenda.pdf

If the time still works, the calendar invite is here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234

If anything changes, please flag here and we can adjust — particularly if you want us to bring the runtime team or your SREs.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

- Mon 29 Mar 2027, 14:00–15:00
- Tue 30 Mar 2027, 09:00–10:00
